data.long_meaning: Jawharaa is derived from the Arabic word 'jawhar' which means 'jewel' or 'gemstone'. It is a unisex name that can be given to either boys or girls. The name Jawharaa carries the meaning “Jewel” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Jawharaa usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawharaa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
